## Highlights
### New
- On Mac, drag a pinned extension along the sidebar to put your extensions in the order you want, as you move tabs. Every Space with the same browsing profile shows them in that order. From the first launch after updating, the strip shows your extensions in the order you pinned them instead of by name. - On Mac, Command-E opens your extensions one at a time: the pinned ones from left to right, then the rest. Press it again for the next one, and once more after the last to close it. Archive Tab moves to Shift-Command-E.
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
